idea-plugin.name: Copilot Pixel Agents
idea-plugin.description:
Pixel Art Office for Your AI Coding Agents

Watch your AI coding agents come to life as animated pixel art characters in a charming virtual office!

Each Claude Code terminal session and GitHub Copilot Chat session gets its own unique character that types, reads, walks around, and reacts in real-time as they work on your code.

Features

  • 🏢 Pixel art office — beautiful retro-style workspace rendered on canvas
  • 🤖 Claude Code integration — each terminal gets a unique animated character
  • 🧑‍💻 GitHub Copilot Chat integration — monitor Copilot activity with a dedicated character
  • 🎨 Layout editor — paint floors, place walls, arrange furniture, customize colors
  • 🎭 6 unique character skins with automatic diverse palette assignment
  • ✨ Matrix-style effects — spawn/despawn digital rain animations
  • 🔔 Sound notifications — audio alerts when agents need attention
  • 📦 Custom asset packs — load external furniture and decoration packs

How It Works

  1. Open the Pixel Agents tool window (bottom panel)
  2. Click + Agent to launch a Claude Code terminal — a character appears in the office
  3. Click + Copilot to monitor GitHub Copilot Chat activity
  4. Watch characters type when coding, read when searching, and wander when idle
  5. Click Layout to customize your office — paint floors, add furniture, rearrange everything

Requirements

  • Claude Code CLI (for terminal agents)
  • GitHub Copilot plugin (optional, for Copilot Chat monitoring)
